corpus.title: Tours and visitor information
corpus.text: Visitor information. The Sydney Opera House is open daily from 9am to 5pm. Guided tours run every thirty minutes throughout the day, and a one-hour tour costs AUD 45 per adult. Tours depart from the Lower Concourse box office, which opens fifteen minutes before the first departure. Step-free access is available at the Western Foyer entrance, and assistance dogs are welcome in all public areas of the building.

corpus.title: Circular Quay station
corpus.text: Getting to Circular Quay. Trains to Circular Quay station run every ten minutes on weekdays and every fifteen minutes on weekends. The station is a seven-minute walk from the Sydney Opera House forecourt, following the harbour promenade past the ferry wharves. Lifts serve all platforms.
